propositions: A completion verify run with an operator-actionable BLOCK banked in the criterion store that subsequently hits a provider outage currently dies verdict-less (exit 11) instead of surfacing the available actionable BLOCK feedback.

When the criterion bank holds a met=False entry with evidence_sufficient not False (a genuine refutation, not an insufficiency placeholder), the completion gate should finalize a deterministic BLOCK verdict from the bank with zero further LLM calls.
An empty criterion bank or a bank containing only PASSes/insufficiency placeholders hit by a provider outage must preserve the retryable exit-11 posture (ADR 0040 unchanged).
A degrade verdict from banked criteria must have certifiable=False and must not auto-close the ticket; operator decision is required (flows to close_precheck non-close branch, returncode 1).
The degrade path must be guarded so any fault in bank-read or criteria-read falls through to re-raise the outage unchanged, never introducing a new failure mode on the recovery path.
